plan.notes: Official UNK catalog sample 4-year plan for the Business Administration BS (Department of Management, College of Business and Technology). Semester subtotals (13/15/15/15/15/15/16/16) and the 120 total match the published plan exactly. Blank cells in the published grid are recorded as labeled General Education/minor/elective choice slots. A minor or second major is required for a complete degree program; the number of electives needed to reach 120 depends on the program chosen. Graduate-course options (MGT 814, 890, 893P, MKT 835P) require admission to the 4+1 MBA accelerated program. This is a sample plan; actual course selection and sequence may vary and should be discussed with an academic advisor.
